items.why: The fear gauge is spiking as the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all drop ahead of a pivotal week for AI.
AI chip stocks are sliding together, with Nvidia and other AI names dragging the market lower ahead of Nvidia earnings.
Headlines say Nvidia is leading AI stocks lower as the Nasdaq slides ahead of its earnings in a pivotal week for AI.
Oil is slipping while stocks fall, with today's headlines noting oil lower alongside gold as Nvidia earnings loom.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down 2.7% and S&P futures down 1.99%, with oil down 3.3%.
summary: Stocks are sharply lower Monday afternoon, with the Nasdaq down about 2% as Nvidia leads AI stocks lower ahead of its results. The VIX is up over 24% as investors brace for a pivotal week for AI.
